policy: Work class, not numeric complexity, selects the route. Ambiguous boundaries route upward.

cases.request: Explain what this already-identified helper does. Do not change anything.
Change one settled UI label in the existing header and run its focused test.
Change the existing plugin version from 0.8.0 to 0.8.1 with no new feature.
Fix the existing retry behavior across the API and worker queue without adding a feature.
Correct the existing event contract shared by the web app and worker.
Add one new CSV export feature to the existing reporting package.
Add one new saved-filter capability spanning the existing API and dashboard.
Release version 2.4 with one new dark-mode preference in the frontend.
Build a new customer portal with login, billing history, and downloadable invoices.
Add a new workflow spanning the TypeScript web app and a new C++ processing executable.
Add the new account model and deploy its irreversible production schema migration.
Build the new collaboration system; the architecture and component boundaries are not decided.
